title: Thai-Style Tofu Skewers with Peanut Satay Sauce
summary: Golden grilled tofu skewers served with a creamy, tangy peanut satay sauce. They make a satisfying vegan snack with Thai-inspired flavours of lime, ginger, soy and chilli.

ingredients.name: firm tofu, drained and cut into 2 cm cubes
soy sauce, for the satay sauce
lime juice, for the satay sauce

steps: Pat the tofu dry with kitchen paper, then place it in a bowl with 2 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tbsp lime juice, grated ginger, crushed garlic and vegetable oil. Toss gently and marinate for 15 minutes while you make the sauce.

For the satay sauce, put the coconut milk, peanut butter, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp lime juice, maple syrup, chilli powder, cumin and a pinch of salt in a small saucepan. Warm over a low heat for 3–5 minutes, whisking until smooth, glossy and slightly thickened. Add a splash of water if it becomes too thick.
Thread the marinated tofu cubes onto skewers. Heat a grill pan or frying pan over medium-high heat until hot.
Cook the tofu skewers for 8–10 minutes, turning every couple of minutes, until the edges are golden brown and lightly charred in places.
Transfer the skewers to a plate, spoon over a little satay sauce, and scatter with chopped coriander. Serve warm with the remaining sauce for dipping.
